mapper.select: SELECT a.application_id, a.applicant_name, a.email, a.phone, a.career_year, a.stage, a.applied_at, j.title AS posting_title, j.posting_id FROM application a JOIN job_posting j ON a.posting_id = j.posting_id ORDER BY a.applied_at DESC
SELECT a.*, j.title AS posting_title FROM application a JOIN job_posting j ON a.posting_id = j.posting_id WHERE a.application_id = #{applicationId}
SELECT a.application_id, a.applicant_name, a.career_year, a.stage, a.posting_id FROM application a WHERE a.stage NOT IN ('REJECTED') ORDER BY a.applied_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO application (posting_id, applicant_name, email, phone, career_year, cover_letter, stage, resume_path, resume_original_name, applied_at) VALUES (#{postingId}, #{applicantName}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{careerYear}, #{coverLetter}, 'RECEIVED', #{resumePath}, #{resumeOriginalName}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE application SET stage = #{stage}, decided_at = CASE WHEN #{stage} IN ('PASSED','REJECTED') THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END, reject_reason = CASE WHEN #{stage} = 'REJECTED' THEN #{rejectReason} ELSE NULL END WHERE application_id = #{applicationId}
mapper.select: SELECT posting_id, title, department FROM job_posting WHERE status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stage_history (application_id, before_stage, after_stage, changed_by, note, changed_at) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{beforeStage}, #{afterStage}, #{changedBy}, #{note}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT a.application_id, a.applicant_name, a.email, a.career_year, a.stage, a.reject_reason, a.decided_at, a.applied_at, p.title AS posting_title, (SELECT sh.before_stage FROM stage_history sh WHERE sh.application_id = a.application_id AND sh.after_stage = 'REJECTED' ORDER BY sh.changed_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS fail_stage, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM application a2 WHERE a2.email = a.email AND a2.applicant_name = a.applicant_name) AS apply_count FROM application a LEFT JOIN job_posting p ON a.posting_id = p.posting_id WHERE a.stage IN ('PASSED', 'REJECTED') ORDER BY a.decided_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE application SET stage = 'RECEIVED', decided_at = NULL, reject_reason = NULL WHERE application_id = #{id}
